💡 Project Abstract

BookVerse is a digital library management platform designed to simplify traditional library operations. It allows students to explore books, research papers, presentations and digital resources in one place. Users can search books, view details and access learning materials easily.

🎯 Objectives
  • Automate library management processes.
  • Provide easy access to books and resources.
  • Maintain accurate book records.
  • Organize digital learning materials.
  • Improve student learning experience.
